advertiser_id.description: ID of the advertiser account the row belongs to.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign. FK to [Campaigns](./campaigns.md)

campaign_name.description: Name of the campaign the row belongs to.

operation_status.description: The on or off status the advertiser set; the delivery status is in `secondary_status`.

optimization_goal.description: What the ad group optimizes delivery for, such as clicks, reach or conversions.

optimization_event.description: The conversion event the ad group optimizes for.

app_type.description: Type of the app the ad group promotes.

audience_ids.description: List of audience IDs. Stored as a JSON string.

excluded_audience_ids.description: List of excluded audience IDs. Stored as a JSON string.

age_groups.description: Target age groups. Stored as a JSON string.

languages.description: Target languages. Stored as a JSON string.

location_ids.description: Target location IDs. Stored as a JSON string.

interest_category_ids.description: IDs of the interest categories the ad group targets. Stored as a JSON string.

placements.description: Ad placements. Stored as a JSON string.

schedule_start_time.description: When the ad group's delivery schedule starts.

schedule_end_time.description: When the ad group's delivery schedule ends.

conversion_id.description: ID of the conversion set on the ad group.

conversion_bid_price.description: The bid per conversion set on the ad group.

conversion_window.description: The conversion window set on the ad group.

click_attribution_window.description: The ad group's click-through attribution window: how long after a click a conversion is credited to the ad.

view_attribution_window.description: The ad group's view-through attribution window: how long after an ad view a conversion is credited to the ad.

targeting_expansion.description: Targeting expansion settings. Stored as a JSON string.

device_price_ranges.description: Target device price ranges. Stored as a JSON string.

device_model_ids.description: Target device model IDs. Stored as a JSON string.

operating_systems.description: Target operating systems. Stored as a JSON string.

network_types.description: Target network types. Stored as a JSON string.

carrier_ids.description: Target carrier IDs. Stored as a JSON string.

date_start.description: First day of the reporting range; the connector fills it from `stat_time_day` when TikTok does not return it.

date_end.description: Last day of the reporting range.

impressions.description: Number of times the ads were shown.

cost.description: Cost. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty; use `spend` for the amount spent.

cost_per_conversion.description: Spend divided by conversions, as TikTok reports it.

conversion_rate.description: Conversions as a percentage of clicks, as TikTok reports it.

reach.description: Number of unique users who saw the ads at least once.

engagement.description: Engagement. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty.

video_views.description: Video views. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty; use `video_play_actions` for video plays.

video_completion.description: Video completions. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty. Use `video_views_p100` for views to the end.

spend.description: Amount spent, in the advertiser account's currency.

profile_visits.description: Visits to the advertiser's profile that came from the ads.

real_time_conversion_rate.description: Conversion rate as TikTok counts it in real time. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty.

cost_per_result.description: Cost per result. The connector does not request this metric, so the column stays empty.
